datasets.name: public-holidays
datasets.title: Public holidays of Romania
datasets.description: The days on which no work is done by law, as rules that give the days of any year and as the days themselves from 2024 to the year after the build. Orthodox Easter Sunday is the Julian computus moved to the civil calendar. Days declared free by a Government decision for one year only are not included. The two days each of three yearly feasts of other legal religions have no fixed date and are not included.

source.name: Labour Code (Law 53/2003, republished), article 139 (1); Orthodox Easter is computed
source.licence: Romanian legislation, not subject to copyright (Law 8/1996, article 9)

datasets.update: When article 139 of the Labour Code changes, and once a year for the next year

fields.description: fixed: the same month and day every year. orthodox-easter-offset: a number of days from Orthodox Easter Sunday

fields.description: The day of the month of a fixed rule; null otherwise

fields.name: easter_offset
